principle: A strategy earns leaderboard points only when every gate it depends on is PASS. A gate that cannot be evaluated with the data captured so far is recorded as NOT TESTABLE and keeps the strategy gated; it is never silently treated as a pass.

gates.name: Official-source integrity
gates.criterion: Every input value comes from an official league, team or network source and every row carries that source URL. No secondary aggregator, no news summary, no inferred value.
gates.why_it_matters: A signal built on an unsourced or mis-transcribed input cannot be audited, and every downstream statistic inherits the error.

gates.name: Minimum sample size
gates.criterion: At least 100 settled, priced bets for the strategy before it may be scored or ranked.
gates.why_it_matters: Below this size the sampling error on any edge estimate is larger than the edge itself, so a lucky run is indistinguishable from skill.

gates.name: Out-of-sample (walk-forward) test
gates.criterion: Performance is measured on games that were played after the signal timestamp; no random shuffle, no in-sample fitting, no feature computed from information published after the line was originated.
gates.why_it_matters: NFL data is autocorrelated and small samples; in-sample fitting manufactures skill that does not exist.

gates.name: Multiple-testing correction
gates.criterion: The number of strategies tested is declared and a Holm-Bonferroni correction (or deflated Sharpe ratio) is applied to the significance threshold before a strategy is called profitable.
gates.why_it_matters: Testing many variations of the same idea guarantees that some look profitable by chance.

gates.name: Statistical significance and confidence interval
gates.criterion: The 95% bootstrap confidence interval for expected edge must exclude zero in the positive direction, and the number of bets must exceed G2.
gates.why_it_matters: An edge that cannot be distinguished from zero is not an edge.

gates.name: Luck / variance control
gates.criterion: The signal is tested against a variance-matched null: the edge must survive controlling for opponent strength, schedule features and one-game noise, and the persistence measured from official season data must explain less variance than the signal itself.
gates.why_it_matters: Most year-to-year NFL movement is luck. A strategy that only wins when the coin flip goes its way is not a strategy.

gates.name: Correlation and effective sample size
gates.criterion: Legs combined in one ticket must have measured |rho| <= 0.30, the ticket is capped at 4 legs, and the reported sample size is the effective sample size n_eff = n / (1 + (k-1) * mean_rho).
gates.why_it_matters: Correlated legs do not multiply independent edges; they multiply one edge and multiply the variance.

gates.name: Robustness across sub-periods and thresholds
gates.criterion: Positive result in at least 60% of seasons tested, and the sign of the edge does not flip when the entry threshold is moved within the stated band.
gates.why_it_matters: A result that depends on one season or one hand-picked threshold is a fit to noise.

gates.name: Price availability and line-movement discipline
gates.criterion: A bet is only recorded when a price exists at the origination timestamp, with the bookmaker/price source and timestamp stored; the line must have been stable for the stated minimum window.
gates.why_it_matters: Without a recorded price there is no edge and no settlement; stale prices are not tradeable prices.

gates.name: Risk limits
gates.criterion: Kelly fraction per bet <= 0.25, weekly exposure cap, and no parlay longer than 4 legs or combining two legs from the same game.
gates.why_it_matters: A correct signal with uncontrolled sizing still produces ruin.

gates.name: Provenance and disclosure
gates.criterion: Every bet record stores the input values, their official source URLs and the capture timestamps, and the site publishes the model parameters used.

gates.name: Settlement integrity
gates.criterion: Bets settle on the official final score from an official source, with pushes handled as pushes and voided games excluded.
gates.why_it_matters: Leaderboard points computed from anything other than the official result are not comparable between strategies.
